prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering the onboarding flow, adding preset fallback choices, and adding background render status indicators were helpful.
Interactive screen redesigns and desktop hint notifications hurt performance.
Copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, hints, and incentives showed no clear effect.
Predictions were underestimated for preset fallback choices and background status indicators.
Predictions were consistently too high for redesigns, hint notifications, copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, and new flow additions.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +1.2% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, incentive: -5.1% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +3.8% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +4.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +3.3% over 2 test(s)
- finish, notification: -8.9% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: -4.5% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +4.8% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -1.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, new_flow: -1.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +8.8% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 65.6%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Photo Upload: Reorder the onboarding sequence to place sign-in directly after photo upload and before adoption certificate creation. (why: Sign-in has an 81.1% completion rate with low median time (3s), but asking users to sign in before choosing their pet disrupts pet selection momentum.)
1: [home, new_screen] Dedicated Render Preparation Screen: Insert a dedicated pre-render status screen before the waiting screen showing asset preparation steps. (why: The home stage waiting process has a long mean duration (2336s) and support emails report pets failing to display on desktop.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Background Status Toggle: Enable background execution status indicators and step counters on the waiting screen. (why: Background render indicators previously helped retention during generation delays.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Status Estimate Badge: Add an active generation status badge component to the waiting screen. (why: Home stage has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s; clear waiting indicators prevent app abandonment.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in has strong historical lift (+8.8%) and addresses early momentum drop.
Adding new screens and redesigns consistently hurt conversion despite high support callout.
Config toggle for background status indicator aligns with proven historical gains (+4.8%).
Status estimate component helps reduce wait dropoff but requires UI changes.
